# Third-party notices

## lunar-javascript

This project depends on [`lunar-javascript`](https://github.com/6tail/lunar-javascript), version 1.7.7, by 6tail.

`lunar-javascript` is distributed under the MIT License. Its copyright and license are included in installed dependency distributions and at its upstream repository.

The dependency supplies low-level Chinese calendar and Eight Characters calculations. `@mingora/bazi` defines its own public types, validation, time-resolution behavior, true-solar-time calculation, analysis models, and application-facing APIs.
